card-1.title: Noj Street
card-1.description: Kev sau ntau yam ntawm cov khw noj mov thoob ntiaj teb
card-1.details: Tshawb nrhiav ntau hom zaub mov los ntawm thoob plaws ntiaj teb ntawm Nicollet Avenue, lub npe hu ua 'Eat Street'. Los ntawm Nyab Laj pho mus rau German schnitzel, muaj qee yam rau txhua lub palate.
card-1.cost: Nws txawv ntawm lub tsev noj mov, feem ntau yog $ 10- $ 30 rau ib tus neeg

card-2.title: Midtown Ntiaj Teb Kev Ua Lag Luam
card-2.description: Sab hauv tsev lag luam thoob ntiaj teb pej xeem
card-2.details: Mus saib qhov chaw ua lag luam zoo nkauj no uas muaj cov neeg muag khoom noj, khw noj mov, thiab khoom plig tshwj xeeb los ntawm thoob plaws ntiaj teb. Tsis txhob plam lub sijhawm los sim cov khoom noj los ntawm ntau haiv neeg nyob hauv ib lub ru tsev.
card-2.cost: Kev nkag dawb, nqi zaub mov txawv

card-3.title: St. Paul Farmers' Market
card-3.description: Cov khoom lag luam tshiab hauv zos thiab cov khoom siv txuj ci
card-3.details: Kawm paub qhov zoo tshaj plaws ntawm Minnesota cov khoom siv hauv zos thiab cov khoom siv cuab yeej cuab tam ntawm cov neeg ua liaj ua teb keeb kwm no. Qhib txhua xyoo, nws yog qhov chaw zoo rau cov khoom noj tshiab thiab ntsib cov neeg tsim khoom hauv zos.
card-3.cost: Kev nkag dawb, tus nqi sib txawv ntawm tus neeg muag khoom

card-4.title: Myriel
card-4.description: Intimate Dining tuaj nrog ib khob qe kas fes
card-4.details: Cov ntawv qhia a la carte tsis muaj nyob online vim nws hloov ntau zaus. Tomlinson ua rau lub ntsej muag nto moo: Yog tias lub ncuav qab zib tshwm rau ntawm cov ntawv qhia zaub mov, xaj nws yam tsis muaj hesitation, thiab khub khoom qab zib nrog Scandinavian qe kas fes.
card-4.cost: $$$, Tasting zaub mov ncig $135 rau ib tug neeg

card-1.title: Minneapolis Institute of Art
card-1.description: Ntiaj teb-class kos duab tsev cia puav pheej nrog dawb nkag
card-1.details: Tshawb nrhiav ntau dua 90,000 cov haujlwm ntawm kev kos duab hla 5,000 xyoo ntawm tib neeg muaj tswv yim. Los ntawm cov khoom qub thaum ub mus rau niaj hnub masterpieces, MIA muab kev paub ntau yam thiab muaj txiaj ntsig zoo rau cov neeg nyiam kos duab.
card-1.cost: Kev nkag mus pub dawb, qee qhov kev nthuav qhia tshwj xeeb yuav muaj tus nqi

card-2.title: Mall of America
card-2.description: Lub khw loj tshaj plaws hauv Tebchaws Meskas
card-2.details: Ntau tshaj li kev yuav khoom, Mall of America muaj qhov chaw ua si sab hauv tsev, thoob dej yug ntses, thiab ntau yam kev lom zem xaiv. Nws yog ib lub nroog nyob rau hauv ib lub nroog thiab ib tug yuav tsum-mus ntsib attraction.
card-2.cost: Kev nkag dawb, tus nqi sib txawv rau kev nyiam thiab yuav khoom

card-3.title: Minnehaha Falls
card-3.description: 53-foot dej tsaws tsag hauv nroog chaw
card-3.details: Txaus siab rau qhov zoo nkauj ntawm Minnehaha Falls, nyob hauv Minnehaha Park. Mus ncig ua si zoo nkauj, noj hmo, lossis so kom txaus los ntawm cov dej cascading hauv nroog oasis.

card-4.title: Science Museum of Minnesota
card-4.description: Sib tham sib science museum nrog stunning dej views
card-4.details: Koom tes nrog cov khoom pov thawj, ntes cov yeeb yam ntawm Omniheater, thiab kawm txog txhua yam ntawm dinosaurs mus rau tib neeg lub cev. Lub tsev khaws puav pheej muaj kev pom zoo nkauj ntawm Mississippi River.
card-4.cost: Cov neeg laus $24.95, Menyuam yaus (4-12) $17.95, Seniors (65+) $22.95

item-2.trigger: Leej twg tuaj yeem tuaj koom ICYPAA?

item-4.content: Yog lawm, muaj nyiaj pab kawm ntawv. Thov mus saib nplooj ntawv sau npe kom paub ntau ntxiv txog kev thov.
